summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan take a trip to Kushiro marshland, Hokkaido Prefecture, to see the red-crowned cranes. They run into an old man who takes care of the cranes and he invites them to his house. His daughter and son rush into the room demanding the reason why he is donating his life savings to the city. The group is allowed to soak in the hot spring near the house, but they are called when they find out the old man has been murdered. Location: Machida household Victim: Shuzo Machida Cause of death: Arrow shot through the chest Suspects: Hiroshi Machida
